desc: Formalize and brute-force validate the segment-aggregated recurrence D_s, including endpoint checks, first-increase compression, and the final answer formula.
Implement a small-N reference solver using the validated recurrence and compare it with direct enumeration of matchings.
Investigate whether the recurrence can be reduced to a single convolution / power-series inversion or another O(N log N) structure, to avoid a heavy CDQ implementation in Python.
If no simpler structure is found, design an efficient online-convolution solver for sum D_p * fact[R_s-p] (CDQ with NTT, relaxed convolution, or a practical sqrt-decomposition fallback).
Implement the optimized solver for N up to 2e5 with fast I/O, factorial precomputation, and careful memory/time handling.
Final integration, edge-case handling, and validation on samples plus randomized small tests.
